clean_apply.method: the generated patch reverse-applies cleanly to the current overlay on the pinned base

removed_environment_failure_classes: system Clang 18 did not implement the pinned source tree's AArch64 compare-and-branch, CREL and pointer-authentication syntax
system assembler and the pinned LLVM producer disagreed on newer directives and relocation encodings
split-DWARF producer/path behavior differed from the pinned test expectations

cross_target_repair.initial_observation: with the pinned compiler, shrink wrapping reported zero spills using load/store insertion and one using push/pop instead of the upstream one/zero contract
cross_target_repair.mechanism: the Cortex-M opaque-region predicate had been passed to buildCallGraph for every target and therefore changed the mature X86 shrink-wrapping graph used to place a restore before a conditional tail-call exit
cross_target_repair.repair: apply the opaque-region call-graph predicate only to ARM/Thumb and call the unmodified buildCallGraph overload on X86

scope_limits: a clean full BOLT suite establishes that the current overlay preserves the pinned suite's X86, AArch64, RISC-V and ARM contracts on this host; 150 target-inapplicable tests remain skipped and 34 dependency/feature cases remain unsupported
the result removes mixed-toolchain ambiguity and one cross-target regression; it does not by itself implement the still-declared Cortex-M layout, state-model or optimization gaps
the 68-profile production matrix and real M4 fixed-work run are preservation and installation evidence, not complete x86-backend feature parity or a statistically powered speedup claim
patch-aware transformation semantics remain a later phase; this production gate uses the current explicit empty patch contract

source_changes.build_contract: the reproducible LLVM build enables the pinned clang project, builds clang/clang++, clears stale BOLT_CLANG_EXE and BOLT_LLD_EXE cache overrides, and tests against the same pinned source revision as llvm-bolt and lld
source_changes.cross_target_isolation: FrameOptimizer uses the firmware opaque-region call-graph filter only for ARM/Thumb and preserves the upstream X86 graph exactly
source_changes.test_contract: the full BOLT suite is now a clean required regression oracle instead of a diagnostic with an accepted mixed-toolchain failure baseline
